newsitem.title: UK: Unilever sells part of microbio business.
newsitem.headline: Unilever sells part of microbio business.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch consumer products conglomerate Unilever Plc said on Wednesday that it had sold the microbiology business of its Unipath subsidiary to British venture capital firm Cinven.
Unilever did not disclose the price of the business.
Unilever said in a statement that Cinven's total funding for the acquisition is 84.6 million stg including banking facilities for working capital and future expansion.

The business, renamed Oxoid Ltd, manufactures and markets culture media and its raw materials. Apart from the UK, it has a manufacturing unit in Wesel, near Dusseldorf in Germany and sales offices across Europe, Australia and Canada.
The business employs 600 people with sales of around 60 million stg.
"The sale results from Unilever's decision to concentrate on Unipath's consumer goods activities," Unilever said.
